devotionals.email_summary: Overload driven by comparison rather than mission produces exhaustion without meaning.

devotionals.title: Leading Without Adding Burden
devotionals.summary: Leadership that restores requires a leader who is not running on empty.
devotionals.email_summary: Leadership that restores requires a leader who is not running on empty.

devotionals.title: Stability Builds Trust
devotionals.summary: Trust is built through consistent groundedness, not through the absence of difficulty.
devotionals.email_summary: Trust is built through consistent groundedness, not through the absence of difficulty.

devotionals.title: When You Need Higher Ground
devotionals.summary: Reaching depletion is not a leadership failure. Pretending you have not is.
devotionals.email_summary: Reaching depletion is not a leadership failure. Pretending you have not is.

devotionals.title: Delivered From Fear
devotionals.summary: Fear managed indefinitely is not fear resolved. It is fear stored.
devotionals.email_summary: Fear managed indefinitely is not fear resolved. It is fear stored.

devotionals.title: Letting Peace Govern
devotionals.summary: Peace is the condition produced when what leads internally is ordered and grounded.
devotionals.email_summary: Peace is the condition produced when what leads internally is ordered and grounded.

devotionals.title: Clarity Begins With Asking
devotionals.summary: Clarity in leadership often begins with asking, not with more analysis.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity in leadership often begins with asking, not with more analysis.

devotionals.title: Taught by God
devotionals.summary: The clarity God offers is not just about what to do. It is about what is genuinely worth doing.
devotionals.email_summary: The clarity God offers is not just about what to do. It is about what is genuinely worth doing.

devotionals.title: The Spirit Guides
devotionals.summary: Clarity is often given in motion, not in advance of it.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity is often given in motion, not in advance of it.

devotionals.title: Led by the Spirit
devotionals.summary: Fear produces a narrow kind of clarity. The leader led by the Spirit operates from freedom.
devotionals.email_summary: Fear produces a narrow kind of clarity. The leader led by the Spirit operates from freedom.

devotionals.title: Understanding What Has Been Given
devotionals.summary: Knowing what you have is not the same as understanding what it is for.
devotionals.email_summary: Knowing what you have is not the same as understanding what it is for.

devotionals.title: A Spirit of Wisdom and Revelation
devotionals.summary: A leader who knows what they are called to is harder to move off course.
devotionals.email_summary: A leader who knows what they are called to is harder to move off course.

devotionals.title: The Word That Gives Light
devotionals.summary: Clarity through Scripture comes through engagement over time, not through a quick scan.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity through Scripture comes through engagement over time, not through a quick scan.

devotionals.title: Eyes Straight Ahead
devotionals.summary: Clarity of direction requires settling where you are going before you focus on how fast to move.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity of direction requires settling where you are going before you focus on how fast to move.

devotionals.title: Wisdom as the Foundation
devotionals.summary: Pride and arrogance separate a leader from the source of the clarity they are seeking.
devotionals.email_summary: Pride and arrogance separate a leader from the source of the clarity they are seeking.

devotionals.title: Clarity Through Counsel
devotionals.summary: Clarity is rarely the product of a single voice, including the leader's own.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity is rarely the product of a single voice, including the leader's own.

devotionals.title: Human Plans, Divine Direction
devotionals.summary: Committed work finds a stability that controlled work cannot generate on its own.
devotionals.email_summary: Committed work finds a stability that controlled work cannot generate on its own.

devotionals.title: Drawing Out Purpose
devotionals.summary: Purpose does not surface on its own. It has to be drawn out with intention.
devotionals.email_summary: Purpose does not surface on its own. It has to be drawn out with intention.

devotionals.title: Built on Understanding
devotionals.summary: Building and establishing are not the same thing. Understanding is what bridges them.
devotionals.email_summary: Building and establishing are not the same thing. Understanding is what bridges them.

devotionals.title: Understanding Produces Stability
devotionals.summary: Long continuity is the result of clarity operating consistently over time.
devotionals.email_summary: Long continuity is the result of clarity operating consistently over time.

devotionals.title: Asking to Be Taught
devotionals.summary: Asking to be taught is a different and deeper posture than seeking answers.
devotionals.email_summary: Asking to be taught is a different and deeper posture than seeking answers.

devotionals.title: Led on a Level Path
devotionals.summary: Clarity is most needed when conditions are hostile, not when they are favorable.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity is most needed when conditions are hostile, not when they are favorable.

devotionals.title: God Instructs the Way
devotionals.summary: Remaining in relationship with the source produces instruction that fits the moment.
devotionals.email_summary: Remaining in relationship with the source produces instruction that fits the moment.

devotionals.title: A Lamp and a Light
devotionals.summary: The Word provides enough light for the next step, not the full picture in advance.
devotionals.email_summary: The Word provides enough light for the next step, not the full picture in advance.

devotionals.title: Make Me Know the Way
devotionals.summary: Knowing the way, being protected on it, and being aligned with what is right are three distinct requests worth making.
devotionals.email_summary: Knowing the way, being protected on it, and being aligned with what is right are three distinct requests worth making.

devotionals.title: This Is the Way
devotionals.summary: Clarity often comes in the moment of deviation, not before it.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity often comes in the moment of deviation, not before it.

devotionals.title: Write the Vision
devotionals.summary: A vision that cannot be written plainly is not yet clear enough to lead from.
devotionals.email_summary: A vision that cannot be written plainly is not yet clear enough to lead from.

devotionals.title: Seek First
devotionals.summary: What you seek first will shape how everything else feels, whether secure or never quite enough.
devotionals.email_summary: What you seek first will shape how everything else feels, whether secure or never quite enough.

devotionals.title: Build on What Is Solid
devotionals.summary: Both builders heard the same words. The difference was what each did with them.
devotionals.email_summary: Both builders heard the same words. The difference was what each did with them.

devotionals.title: Count the Cost
devotionals.summary: An honestly assessed gap can be addressed. An unaddressed gap becomes visible at the worst possible time.
devotionals.email_summary: An honestly assessed gap can be addressed. An unaddressed gap becomes visible at the worst possible time.

devotionals.title: Think Over What I Say
devotionals.summary: Some of the clarity you are looking for may already be in your hands, waiting for you to think it over.
devotionals.email_summary: Some of the clarity you are looking for may already be in your hands, waiting for you to think it over.

devotionals.title: Test Everything
devotionals.summary: Leadership clarity requires both openness to what is unfamiliar and discernment about what is good.
devotionals.email_summary: Leadership clarity requires both openness to what is unfamiliar and discernment about what is good.

devotionals.title: Walk Carefully
devotionals.summary: Making the best use of time requires understanding what is actually being asked, not just filling the time with activity.
devotionals.email_summary: Making the best use of time requires understanding what is actually being asked, not just filling the time with activity.

devotionals.title: The Word That Discerns
devotionals.summary: A leader can be clear about what they are doing and still be unclear about why. The Word reaches the why.
devotionals.email_summary: A leader can be clear about what they are doing and still be unclear about why. The Word reaches the why.

devotionals.title: Plans for a Future
devotionals.summary: Clarity about where things are going does not require favorable circumstances. It requires trust in the one who holds the plan.
devotionals.email_summary: Clarity about where things are going does not require favorable circumstances. It requires trust in the one who holds the plan.

devotionals.title: Understanding in Everything
devotionals.summary: The leader who stays with the source long enough will find they are more complete than when they started.
devotionals.email_summary: The leader who stays with the source long enough will find they are more complete than when they started.

devotionals.title: Words Carry Life and Death
devotionals.summary: What a leader produces with their words, they also consume. You inhabit the environment your speech builds.
devotionals.email_summary: What a leader produces with their words, they also consume. You inhabit the environment your speech builds.

devotionals.title: The Tongue Has Power to Heal
devotionals.summary: The same difficult truth can wound or heal depending on whether it was considered before it was spoken.
devotionals.email_summary: The same difficult truth can wound or heal depending on whether it was considered before it was spoken.

devotionals.title: A Gentle Tongue Breaks Bone
devotionals.summary: Gentleness is not weakness. It is a different category of strength that operates over time.
devotionals.email_summary: Gentleness is not weakness. It is a different category of strength that operates over time.

devotionals.title: Freedom and the Tongue
devotionals.summary: Freedom in communication is not the absence of restraint. It is restraint directed by love toward others.
devotionals.email_summary: Freedom in communication is not the absence of restraint. It is restraint directed by love toward others.

devotionals.title: Let No Corrupting Talk Come Out
devotionals.summary: The standard for leadership speech is not accuracy alone. It is whether words build up, fit the occasion, and give grace.
devotionals.email_summary: The standard for leadership speech is not accuracy alone. It is whether words build up, fit the occasion, and give grace.

devotionals.title: The Tongue Is a Fire
devotionals.summary: Small careless words can produce disproportionately large consequences.
devotionals.email_summary: Small careless words can produce disproportionately large consequences.

devotionals.title: No One Can Tame the Tongue
devotionals.summary: The tongue resists taming by human effort alone. Self-discipline is necessary but not sufficient.
devotionals.email_summary: The tongue resists taming by human effort alone. Self-discipline is necessary but not sufficient.

devotionals.title: Guard Your Mouth
devotionals.summary: Unguarded speech accumulates damage quietly over time before the ruin becomes visible.
devotionals.email_summary: Unguarded speech accumulates damage quietly over time before the ruin becomes visible.

devotionals.title: Even a Fool Is Counted Wise
devotionals.summary: The leader who knows when not to speak carries authority that reactive speech undermines.
devotionals.email_summary: The leader who knows when not to speak carries authority that reactive speech undermines.

devotionals.title: A Word Fitly Spoken
devotionals.summary: The right content at the wrong moment does not land as intended. Timing is part of what makes a word fit.
devotionals.email_summary: The right content at the wrong moment does not land as intended. Timing is part of what makes a word fit.

devotionals.title: A Time to Keep Silence
devotionals.summary: Silence and speech are both necessary. The wisdom is knowing which the moment requires.
devotionals.email_summary: Silence and speech are both necessary. The wisdom is knowing which the moment requires.

devotionals.title: Whoever Restrains His Words
devotionals.summary: More words predictably produce more error. Volume is a communication risk factor.
devotionals.email_summary: More words predictably produce more error. Volume is a communication risk factor.

devotionals.title: The Heart of the Wise Weighs
devotionals.summary: Knowing what to say and knowing how to say it are separate questions. The wise leader addresses both.
devotionals.email_summary: Knowing what to say and knowing how to say it are separate questions. The wise leader addresses both.

devotionals.title: The Discerning Heart Speaks Well
devotionals.summary: Persuasiveness that lasts flows from a wise heart, not from technique applied on top of an unformed character.
devotionals.email_summary: Persuasiveness that lasts flows from a wise heart, not from technique applied on top of an unformed character.

devotionals.title: Speaking the Truth in Love
devotionals.summary: The standard is not truth or peace. It is truth that makes for peace.
devotionals.email_summary: The standard is not truth or peace. It is truth that makes for peace.

devotionals.title: Let Your Yes Be Yes
devotionals.summary: Simplicity in communication is a form of integrity. It requires only committing to what you intend to do.
devotionals.email_summary: Simplicity in communication is a form of integrity. It requires only committing to what you intend to do.

devotionals.title: Put Away Falsehood
devotionals.summary: A leader who cannot be trusted to speak plainly corrupts the integrity of the entire team.
devotionals.email_summary: A leader who cannot be trusted to speak plainly corrupts the integrity of the entire team.

devotionals.title: Faithful Rebuke
devotionals.summary: Flattery manages people. Honest rebuke builds them. The difference shows up over time.
devotionals.email_summary: Flattery manages people. Honest rebuke builds them. The difference shows up over time.

devotionals.title: Iron Sharpens Iron
devotionals.summary: Sharpening requires friction. A culture that avoids all friction produces dull edges, not sharp ones.
devotionals.email_summary: Sharpening requires friction. A culture that avoids all friction produces dull edges, not sharp ones.

devotionals.title: Correcting With Gentleness
devotionals.summary: Gentleness in correction keeps the door open for the outcome correction is actually meant to produce.
devotionals.email_summary: Gentleness in correction keeps the door open for the outcome correction is actually meant to produce.

devotionals.title: He Who Answers Before Listening
devotionals.summary: Answering before hearing produces responses shaped by incomplete understanding.
devotionals.email_summary: Answering before hearing produces responses shaped by incomplete understanding.

devotionals.title: A Gentle Tongue Is a Tree of Life
devotionals.summary: A gentle tongue produces life in the people around it over time. The fruit accumulates slowly.
devotionals.email_summary: A gentle tongue produces life in the people around it over time. The fruit accumulates slowly.

devotionals.title: Pleasant Words Are Like Honey
devotionals.summary: What a leader says consistently affects the health of the people they lead in ways that extend beyond the immediate conversation.
devotionals.email_summary: What a leader says consistently affects the health of the people they lead in ways that extend beyond the immediate conversation.

devotionals.title: Gracious Words Pour From the Wise
devotionals.summary: Judicious speech flows from a wise heart. It cannot be reliably produced by technique applied on top of an unformed interior.
devotionals.email_summary: Judicious speech flows from a wise heart. It cannot be reliably produced by technique applied on top of an unformed interior.

devotionals.title: Like a Dog Seizing Ears
devotionals.summary: A leader whose involvement is selective carries more weight when they do choose to enter a dispute.
devotionals.email_summary: A leader whose involvement is selective carries more weight when they do choose to enter a dispute.

devotionals.title: A Fool Gives Full Vent
devotionals.summary: The team that does not have to manage their leader's emotions is free to do the work they were actually hired to do.
devotionals.email_summary: The team that does not have to manage their leader's emotions is free to do the work they were actually hired to do.

devotionals.title: Do Not Speak Rashly
devotionals.summary: A pause between stimulus and response is where wisdom enters the conversation.
devotionals.email_summary: A pause between stimulus and response is where wisdom enters the conversation.

devotionals.title: Bless and Do Not Curse
devotionals.summary: Genuine presence with another person's joy or grief cannot be replicated by performing the appropriate response.
devotionals.email_summary: Genuine presence with another person's joy or grief cannot be replicated by performing the appropriate response.

devotionals.title: Do Not Repay Evil for Evil
devotionals.summary: The quality of a leader's speech is directly connected to the quality of the life they are building.
devotionals.email_summary: The quality of a leader's speech is directly connected to the quality of the life they are building.

devotionals.title: How Forceful Are Honest Words
devotionals.summary: Words that carry force carry it because they carry truth.
devotionals.email_summary: Words that carry force carry it because they carry truth.

devotionals.title: Whoever Loves Life, Keep Your Tongue
devotionals.summary: Guard the tongue not out of fear of what careless words cost, but out of desire for what careful words build.
devotionals.email_summary: Guard the tongue not out of fear of what careless words cost, but out of desire for what careful words build.

devotionals.title: Where Are You
devotionals.summary: Accountability begins with whether the leader answers honestly the first time it is asked.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability begins with whether the leader answers honestly the first time it is asked.

devotionals.title: Am I My Brother's Keeper
devotionals.summary: The people entrusted to a leader remain the leader's accountability, in success and in failure.
devotionals.email_summary: The people entrusted to a leader remain the leader's accountability, in success and in failure.

devotionals.title: Be Sure Your Sin Will Find You Out
devotionals.summary: Accountability does not stay quiet. It surfaces in the record of what a leader actually did.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability does not stay quiet. It surfaces in the record of what a leader actually did.

devotionals.title: Achan's Confession
devotionals.summary: Accountability offered before it is demanded is what makes an account trustworthy.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability offered before it is demanded is what makes an account trustworthy.

devotionals.title: Our Secret Sins in the Light
devotionals.summary: Accountability for a leader's private decisions does not wait for a public moment.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability for a leader's private decisions does not wait for a public moment.

devotionals.title: Nothing Stays Hidden
devotionals.summary: Accountability that exists only in public is not accountability at all.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability that exists only in public is not accountability at all.

devotionals.title: Each Will Give Account
devotionals.summary: Accountability owed for one's self is a debt no amount of leadership can transfer.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability owed for one's self is a debt no amount of leadership can transfer.

devotionals.title: Much Required
devotionals.summary: What was given in trust is what will be required in full.
devotionals.email_summary: What was given in trust is what will be required in full.

devotionals.title: Settling the Account
devotionals.summary: Accountability for what you were given includes what you built with it, not only what you protected.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability for what you were given includes what you built with it, not only what you protected.

devotionals.title: The Governor Who Refused the Allowance
devotionals.summary: The accountability that matters most is the kind no one is checking but you.
devotionals.email_summary: The accountability that matters most is the kind no one is checking but you.

devotionals.title: Stewards, Not Owners
devotionals.summary: What was placed in your care was never yours to begin with, and the accountability follows accordingly.
devotionals.email_summary: What was placed in your care was never yours to begin with, and the accountability follows accordingly.

devotionals.title: Use What Was Given
devotionals.summary: A gift left unused is still a form of unfaithfulness, even when it looks like humility.
devotionals.email_summary: A gift left unused is still a form of unfaithfulness, even when it looks like humility.

devotionals.title: Guard the Deposit
devotionals.summary: What was entrusted to you in trust must be carried forward in trust, not simply left untouched.
devotionals.email_summary: What was entrusted to you in trust must be carried forward in trust, not simply left untouched.

devotionals.title: So That No One Can Blame Us
devotionals.summary: The most credible leaders are not the ones who insist they can be trusted. They are the ones who make their trustworthiness checkable.
devotionals.email_summary: The most credible leaders are not the ones who insist they can be trusted. They are the ones who make their trustworthiness checkable.

devotionals.title: Shepherds Who Fed Themselves
devotionals.summary: A shepherd who is well fed while the sheep go unattended has failed at the one thing the role was for.
devotionals.email_summary: A shepherd who is well fed while the sheep go unattended has failed at the one thing the role was for.

devotionals.title: I Will Not Cease to Pray for You
devotionals.summary: Real accountability to those you lead does not expire the moment your authority does.
devotionals.email_summary: Real accountability to those you lead does not expire the moment your authority does.

devotionals.title: Managing Your Own Household First
devotionals.summary: Accountability to those you lead in public is only as real as the accountability you already practice at home.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability to those you lead in public is only as real as the accountability you already practice at home.

devotionals.title: Do Not Say We Did Not Know
devotionals.summary: Claimed ignorance does not hold up against a heart that was actually paying attention.
devotionals.email_summary: Claimed ignorance does not hold up against a heart that was actually paying attention.

devotionals.title: Examples, Not Domineering
devotionals.summary: Accountability to those you lead includes accountability for whether you have become what you are asking them to become.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability to those you lead includes accountability for whether you have become what you are asking them to become.

devotionals.title: Search Me
devotionals.summary: Accountability to those you lead is completed by accountability to what is actually in you, invited rather than avoided.
devotionals.email_summary: Accountability to those you lead is completed by accountability to what is actually in you, invited rather than avoided.

devotionals.title: I Am Innocent of the Blood of All
devotionals.summary: The accountability you owe to those you lead is only real if you act on it while you still have the chance.
devotionals.email_summary: The accountability you owe to those you lead is only real if you act on it while you still have the chance.

devotionals.title: So I Threw It Into the Fire, and Out Came This Calf
devotionals.summary: Aaron's excuse to Moses is the oldest leadership dodge there is: describe the failure as something that happened to you.
devotionals.email_summary: Aaron's excuse to Moses is the oldest leadership dodge there is: describe the failure as something that happened to you.

devotionals.title: You Will Not Call to Account
devotionals.summary: Avoiding accountability rarely starts as an argument. It starts as a quiet decision that no one will ever call this to account.
devotionals.email_summary: Avoiding accountability rarely starts as an argument. It starts as a quiet decision that no one will ever call this to account.

devotionals.title: Jonah Rose to Flee
devotionals.summary: Jonah does not argue with his assignment. He just leaves in the opposite direction.
devotionals.email_summary: Jonah does not argue with his assignment. He just leaves in the opposite direction.

devotionals.title: If We Say We Have No Sin
devotionals.summary: The claim to be without fault is not innocence. John calls it self-deception.
devotionals.email_summary: The claim to be without fault is not innocence. John calls it self-deception.

devotionals.title: The Heart Is Deceitful Above All Things
devotionals.summary: Jeremiah names the one witness every avoider trusts completely and warns that it cannot be trusted at all.
devotionals.email_summary: Jeremiah names the one witness every avoider trusts completely and warns that it cannot be trusted at all.

devotionals.title: His Eyes Are on the Ways of a Man
devotionals.summary: Elihu insists there is no hiding place dark enough to escape being seen, and no delay built into the judgment either.
devotionals.email_summary: Elihu insists there is no hiding place dark enough to escape being seen, and no delay built into the judgment either.

devotionals.title: The Lord Looks on the Heart
devotionals.summary: Samuel looks at Eliab and sees a king. God looks at the same man and sees someone he has already rejected.
devotionals.email_summary: Samuel looks at Eliab and sees a king. God looks at the same man and sees someone he has already rejected.

devotionals.title: Whoever Conceals His Transgressions
devotionals.summary: The proverb offers a real choice with a real difference in outcome: concealment or confession, and only one of them leads anywhere good.
devotionals.email_summary: The proverb offers a real choice with a real difference in outcome: concealment or confession, and only one of them leads anywhere good.

devotionals.title: I Have Sinned Against the Lord
devotionals.summary: David does not explain, minimize, or defend. He says one true sentence and lets it stand.
devotionals.email_summary: David does not explain, minimize, or defend. He says one true sentence and lets it stand.

devotionals.title: The Integrity of the Upright Guides Them
devotionals.summary: Integrity does not just accuse a leader after failure. It guides them before it, and that is where accountability was always meant to begin.
devotionals.email_summary: Integrity does not just accuse a leader after failure. It guides them before it, and that is where accountability was always meant to begin.

devotionals.title: What the Lord Requires
devotionals.summary: Mercy is stated as a requirement, not a reward for meeting a harder standard first.
devotionals.email_summary: Mercy is stated as a requirement, not a reward for meeting a harder standard first.

devotionals.title: Merciful and Just at Once
devotionals.summary: God names mercy and justice in the same breath, refusing to trade one for the other.
devotionals.email_summary: God names mercy and justice in the same breath, refusing to trade one for the other.

devotionals.title: Mercy as Imitation
devotionals.summary: Mercy modeled after the Father is aimed at people unlikely to ever return it.
devotionals.email_summary: Mercy modeled after the Father is aimed at people unlikely to ever return it.

devotionals.title: As You Were Forgiven
devotionals.summary: Forgiveness is measured against what was received, not against how the current offense feels.
devotionals.email_summary: Forgiveness is measured against what was received, not against how the current offense feels.

devotionals.title: Choosing Mercy Over the Payback You're Owed
devotionals.summary: Joseph holds total leverage over his brothers and chooses not to use it.
devotionals.email_summary: Joseph holds total leverage over his brothers and chooses not to use it.

devotionals.title: Angry That Mercy Was Shown
devotionals.summary: Jonah believes the doctrine of mercy completely and still resents it applied to people he resents.
devotionals.email_summary: Jonah believes the doctrine of mercy completely and still resents it applied to people he resents.

devotionals.title: Restoring Gently
devotionals.summary: Restoring someone gently and watching your own exposure to the same failure are one instruction.
devotionals.email_summary: Restoring someone gently and watching your own exposure to the same failure are one instruction.

devotionals.title: A Tender Heart, Put Into Practice
devotionals.summary: A tender heart is named as the condition mercy depends on, not something leadership experience should harden away.
devotionals.email_summary: A tender heart is named as the condition mercy depends on, not something leadership experience should harden away.

devotionals.title: Kindness Presumed Upon
devotionals.summary: Judging someone for a shared failure and presuming on patience are named as the same posture, not two separate problems.
devotionals.email_summary: Judging someone for a shared failure and presuming on patience are named as the same posture, not two separate problems.

devotionals.title: Kindness for Someone Else's Sake
devotionals.summary: David's kindness to Mephibosheth is decided before Mephibosheth ever proves himself.
devotionals.email_summary: David's kindness to Mephibosheth is decided before Mephibosheth ever proves himself.

devotionals.title: While He Was Still a Long Way Off
devotionals.summary: Mercy runs out to meet the failure before the apology is finished.
devotionals.email_summary: Mercy runs out to meet the failure before the apology is finished.

devotionals.title: The Glory of Overlooking an Offense
devotionals.summary: Overlooking an offense is named as glory in this proverb, not weakness.
devotionals.email_summary: Overlooking an offense is named as glory in this proverb, not weakness.

devotionals.title: Charge It to My Account
devotionals.summary: Paul asks Philemon to charge a real debt to his own account rather than simply asking for forgiveness.
devotionals.email_summary: Paul asks Philemon to charge a real debt to his own account rather than simply asking for forgiveness.

devotionals.title: He Went to Him
devotionals.summary: The Samaritan's compassion becomes oil, wine, transportation, and an open account, not just a feeling.
devotionals.email_summary: The Samaritan's compassion becomes oil, wine, transportation, and an open account, not just a feeling.

devotionals.title: The Lord Disciplines the One He Loves
devotionals.summary: Discipline is named as evidence of love in this passage, not a departure from it.
devotionals.email_summary: Discipline is named as evidence of love in this passage, not a departure from it.

devotionals.title: Do Not Despise the Lord's Discipline
devotionals.summary: Correction from someone who delights in you looks different than correction from someone who merely tolerates you.
devotionals.email_summary: Correction from someone who delights in you looks different than correction from someone who merely tolerates you.

devotionals.title: Those Whom I Love, I Reprove
devotionals.summary: Reproof aimed at someone already loved is evidence of an active relationship, not a threat to it.
devotionals.email_summary: Reproof aimed at someone already loved is evidence of an active relationship, not a threat to it.

devotionals.title: With Complete Patience and Teaching
devotionals.summary: Patience is asked to cover the full range from gentle correction to direct rebuke, not just the easier end.
devotionals.email_summary: Patience is asked to cover the full range from gentle correction to direct rebuke, not just the easier end.

devotionals.title: Bringing Back the One Who Wanders
devotionals.summary: Bringing someone back from wandering is an active pursuit, not a passive observation.
devotionals.email_summary: Bringing someone back from wandering is an active pursuit, not a passive observation.

devotionals.title: He Gently Leads Those With Young
devotionals.summary: Strength and gentleness are shown as the same character, not competing instincts.
devotionals.email_summary: Strength and gentleness are shown as the same character, not competing instincts.

devotionals.title: He Does Not Deal With Us According to Our Sins
devotionals.summary: Mercy here is restraint from a fully warranted response, not the absence of grounds for one.
devotionals.email_summary: Mercy here is restraint from a fully warranted response, not the absence of grounds for one.

devotionals.title: Love Your Enemies, Pray for Those Who Persecute You
devotionals.summary: Mercy toward someone with no baseline goodwill is where a leader's actual capacity for it gets revealed.
devotionals.email_summary: Mercy toward someone with no baseline goodwill is where a leader's actual capacity for it gets revealed.

devotionals.title: Esau Ran to Meet Him
devotionals.summary: Esau extends reconciliation without requiring an apology or confession first.
devotionals.email_summary: Esau extends reconciliation without requiring an apology or confession first.

devotionals.title: Father, Forgive Them
devotionals.summary: Forgiveness given with no expectation of it being noticed or received may be the hardest form mercy takes.
devotionals.email_summary: Forgiveness given with no expectation of it being noticed or received may be the hardest form mercy takes.

devotionals.title: Lord, Do Not Hold This Sin Against Them
devotionals.summary: Genuine mercy shows up under real pressure. Mercy that only appears when it's comfortable hasn't actually been tested yet.
devotionals.email_summary: Genuine mercy shows up under real pressure. Mercy that only appears when it's comfortable hasn't actually been tested yet.

devotionals.title: If Your Enemy Is Hungry, Feed Him
devotionals.summary: Never avenging yourself is the easier half of this instruction. Actively providing for an enemy is the harder, more specific one.
devotionals.email_summary: Never avenging yourself is the easier half of this instruction. Actively providing for an enemy is the harder, more specific one.

devotionals.title: Love Covers a Multitude of Sins
devotionals.summary: Covering a multitude of sins is an ongoing posture toward accumulated small failures, not one dramatic act of forgiveness.
devotionals.email_summary: Covering a multitude of sins is an ongoing posture toward accumulated small failures, not one dramatic act of forgiveness.

devotionals.title: Blessed Are the Merciful
devotionals.summary: Mercy shown and mercy received are described as one connected pattern, not two separate transactions.
devotionals.email_summary: Mercy shown and mercy received are described as one connected pattern, not two separate transactions.

devotionals.title: He Delights in Steadfast Love
devotionals.summary: Mercy that keeps the offense easily reachable for later isn't the complete mercy this verse describes.
devotionals.email_summary: Mercy that keeps the offense easily reachable for later isn't the complete mercy this verse describes.

devotionals.title: Mercy Triumphs Over Judgment
devotionals.summary: The judgment a leader can expect is tied directly to the mercy they were willing to extend, not abstractly related to it.
devotionals.email_summary: The judgment a leader can expect is tied directly to the mercy they were willing to extend, not abstractly related to it.

devotionals.title: Work It and Keep It
devotionals.summary: Stewardship holds two responsibilities at once, developing what was entrusted and protecting it, and most leaders quietly neglect one of them.
devotionals.email_summary: Stewardship holds two responsibilities at once, developing what was entrusted and protecting it, and most leaders quietly neglect one of them.

devotionals.title: The Earth Is the Lord's
devotionals.summary: Every person a leader oversees belonged to God first, which is true even for the founder who built the organization from nothing.
devotionals.email_summary: Every person a leader oversees belonged to God first, which is true even for the founder who built the organization from nothing.

devotionals.title: Given to the Children of Man
devotionals.summary: Real stewardship involves real authority, and what has genuinely been given becomes the responsibility of the one who received it.
devotionals.email_summary: Real stewardship involves real authority, and what has genuinely been given becomes the responsibility of the one who received it.

devotionals.title: Strangers and Sojourners
devotionals.summary: Every leadership role is temporary, and stewardship includes protecting the future of what a leader holds, not only its present condition.
devotionals.email_summary: Every leadership role is temporary, and stewardship includes protecting the future of what a leader holds, not only its present condition.

devotionals.title: The Might of My Hand
devotionals.summary: The story a leader tells about their own success decides what they will do with what they have.
devotionals.email_summary: The story a leader tells about their own success decides what they will do with what they have.

devotionals.title: He Must Increase
devotionals.summary: Influence cannot be seized, only received, which is what makes it possible to rejoice when someone else increases.
devotionals.email_summary: Influence cannot be seized, only received, which is what makes it possible to rejoice when someone else increases.

devotionals.title: The Lord Gave
devotionals.summary: Stewardship does not remove grief over loss, but it removes the claim that something was stolen.
devotionals.email_summary: Stewardship does not remove grief over loss, but it removes the claim that something was stolen.

devotionals.title: The Measure of My Days
devotionals.summary: Time is the one entrusted resource a leader cannot earn back, which makes asking to feel its limit a practical act rather than a morbid one.
devotionals.email_summary: Time is the one entrusted resource a leader cannot earn back, which makes asking to feel its limit a practical act rather than a morbid one.

devotionals.title: A Mist That Appears for a Little Time
devotionals.summary: The problem is not the plan but the certainty attached to a future that has not been given yet.
devotionals.email_summary: The problem is not the plan but the certainty attached to a future that has not been given yet.

devotionals.title: Plow in the Autumn
devotionals.summary: Work with a season attached cannot be recovered by effort later, and most of a leader's most consequential work shows no result on the day it is done.
devotionals.email_summary: Work with a season attached cannot be recovered by effort later, and most of a leader's most consequential work shows no result on the day it is done.

devotionals.title: Go to the Ant
devotionals.summary: Diligence without supervision is the test this proverb sets, for a leader and for the people they lead.
devotionals.email_summary: Diligence without supervision is the test this proverb sets, for a leader and for the people they lead.

devotionals.title: Whatever Your Hand Finds to Do
devotionals.summary: The reason given for wholehearted work is the closing window, not the worthiness of the assignment.
devotionals.email_summary: The reason given for wholehearted work is the closing window, not the worthiness of the assignment.

devotionals.title: One Thing Is Necessary
devotionals.summary: Good work can crowd out the necessary work, and it almost never feels like a mistake while it is happening.
devotionals.email_summary: Good work can crowd out the necessary work, and it almost never feels like a mistake while it is happening.

devotionals.title: Come Away and Rest a While
devotionals.summary: Rest offered in the middle of good work is a different decision than rest granted after someone collapses.
devotionals.email_summary: Rest offered in the middle of good work is a different decision than rest granted after someone collapses.

devotionals.title: Know Well the Condition of Your Flocks
devotionals.summary: Reported condition and actual condition are different numbers, and the distance between them is where failures grow unnoticed.
devotionals.email_summary: Reported condition and actual condition are different numbers, and the distance between them is where failures grow unnoticed.

devotionals.title: Consider Your Ways
devotionals.summary: When output keeps falling short of input, the problem is allocation rather than effort, and leaders usually respond by pushing harder on the same arrangement.
devotionals.email_summary: When output keeps falling short of input, the problem is allocation rather than effort, and leaders usually respond by pushing harder on the same arrangement.

devotionals.title: Where There Are No Oxen
devotionals.summary: The cost and the capacity are usually the same animal, and a clean manger can mean discipline or avoidance.
devotionals.email_summary: The cost and the capacity are usually the same animal, and a clean manger can mean discipline or avoidance.

devotionals.title: That Nothing May Be Lost
devotionals.summary: Abundance reveals whether a leader's care for resources was a value or only a reaction to fear.
devotionals.email_summary: Abundance reveals whether a leader's care for resources was a value or only a reaction to fear.

devotionals.title: Leave the Edges
devotionals.summary: Generosity designed into the harvest does not depend on how a leader feels at the end of a hard year.
devotionals.email_summary: Generosity designed into the harvest does not depend on how a leader feels at the end of a hard year.

devotionals.title: Wealth Sprouts Wings
devotionals.summary: Knowing when to stop acquiring is a skill rather than a loss of nerve, and what is held tightly can still disappear.
devotionals.email_summary: Knowing when to stop acquiring is a skill rather than a loss of nerve, and what is held tightly can still disappear.

devotionals.title: Rich in Good Works
devotionals.summary: Readiness is the test of generosity, because generosity that needs an internal negotiation every time is not ready.
devotionals.email_summary: Readiness is the test of generosity, because generosity that needs an internal negotiation every time is not ready.

devotionals.title: I Bore the Loss Myself
devotionals.summary: A steward who absorbs the losses is doing something different from one who only reports them.
devotionals.email_summary: A steward who absorbs the losses is doing something different from one who only reports them.

devotionals.title: Before the Sun Sets
devotionals.summary: Holding what is owed is treated as oppression even when nothing is stolen, because the delay costs the one waiting far more than the one holding.
devotionals.email_summary: Holding what is owed is treated as oppression even when nothing is stolen, because the delay costs the one waiting far more than the one holding.

devotionals.title: When It Is in Your Power
devotionals.summary: Having the power to give is what creates the obligation, which removes a leader's usual excuse for waiting.
devotionals.email_summary: Having the power to give is what creates the obligation, which removes a leader's usual excuse for waiting.

devotionals.title: They Shall Share Alike
devotionals.summary: Visibility and contribution are not the same measure, and only one of them is easy to see.
devotionals.email_summary: Visibility and contribution are not the same measure, and only one of them is easy to see.

devotionals.title: Keeps a Thing Covered
devotionals.summary: People calibrate what they tell a leader based on what they have watched that leader repeat.
devotionals.email_summary: People calibrate what they tell a leader based on what they have watched that leader repeat.

devotionals.title: Genuinely Concerned for Your Welfare
devotionals.summary: Competence is common and genuine concern for other people is not, which is why who a leader sends says more than who they keep.
devotionals.email_summary: Competence is common and genuine concern for other people is not, which is why who a leader sends says more than who they keep.

devotionals.title: Not What Is Yours, but You
devotionals.summary: A leader entrusted with people is expected to be spent on them rather than the other way around.
devotionals.email_summary: A leader entrusted with people is expected to be spent on them rather than the other way around.
